connector.name: Atlassian Dc MCP Jira by b1ff
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Atlassian Jira Data Center - search, view, and create issues
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package jira. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the b1ff account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ATLASSIAN_DC_MCP_CONFIG_FILE
env.description: Absolute path to a shared dotenv-style config file. When set, values are read from this file before direct environment variable overrides are applied.

env.name: JIRA_HOST
env.description: Jira host domain (e.g. your-instance.atlassian.net). Required unless provided through ATLASSIAN_DC_MCP_CONFIG_FILE or JIRA_API_BASE_PATH.

env.name: JIRA_API_BASE_PATH
env.description: Jira API base path (alternative to JIRA_HOST). Required unless provided through ATLASSIAN_DC_MCP_CONFIG_FILE or JIRA_HOST.

env.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
env.description: Jira Personal Access Token or API token. Required unless provided through ATLASSIAN_DC_MCP_CONFIG_FILE.
